relationships.subject: CRMP2
relationships.evidence_quote: CRMP2 bound to hNaV1.7-CRS with a KD six-fold lower than that of any of the other hNaV1.x peptides

relationships.subject: Nav1.7-CRS peptide
relationships.evidence_quote: In DRG neurons, acute application of 5 µM Myr-TAT-NaV1.7-CRS reduced sodium current density

relationships.subject: Nav1.7-CRS peptide
relationships.evidence_quote: We found an ~80% decrease in evoked CGRP from spinal cords treated with Myr-TAT-NaV1.7-CRS (5 µM) compared to Myr-TAT-SCR or 0.1% DMSO controls

relationships.subject: Nav1.7-CRS peptide
relationships.evidence_quote: observed a >5 h reversal of the mechanical hypersensitivity induced by nerve injury

relationships.subject: AAV9-NaV1.7-CRS
relationships.evidence_quote: mice injected with AAV9-NaV1.7-CRS were resistant to the development of mechanical allodynia after SNI surgery

key_findings: A CRMP2 regulatory sequence unique to Nav1.7 is required for CRMP2 coupling; a decoy peptide reduces Nav1.7 currents, trafficking and spinal CGRP release.
AAV-delivered CRS reversed and prevented neuropathic allodynia and reversed paclitaxel-induced allodynia without motor impairment.
